SELECTED_INDEX: 2
CONFIDENCE: 0.36
EXPLANATION: 1) The very intense line at 1294 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of the symmetric νs(NO₂) stretch of an aliphatic nitro group, a feature present only in candidate 2.  
2) A strong ester C=O at 1723 cm⁻¹ matches the acetate carbonyl in 2, while the 1652 cm⁻¹ band corresponds to the C=C stretch of the allyl fragment.  
3) The spectrum shows both sp³ C–H stretches (2896–2953 cm⁻¹) and sp² C–H stretches (3031–3099 cm⁻¹), consistent with the mixture of saturated and vinylic C–H bonds in 2.  
4) Methyl– and methylene-bending bands at 1428 and 1382 cm⁻¹, plus out-of-plane CH wagging of a trans-alkene near 950 cm⁻¹ (peaks at 952, 911, 890 cm⁻¹), all fit the allyl group in 2.  
No other candidate combines an acetate carbonyl, an aliphatic nitro group, and an allyl double bond, so candidate 2 best matches the observed Raman pattern.
